name: Kogu Hardware
description: Kogu Hardware is a calm, documentary-styled WordPress store theme designed for neighbourhood merchants, craftspeople, and independent shops. Rooted in the story of an Alder Row hardware shop established in 1987, it features hairline-ruled ledger grids, full-bleed photography, and thoughtful WooCommerce drawer templates. The theme balances practical utility with quiet craftsmanship to showcase products, counter services, and repair workflows. Works without WooCommerce.

store.withoutPlugin: The Drawers page lists the six pieces with photographs and USD prices. Orders are taken at the counter, by phone or by email. Cart and checkout are not used without WooCommerce.
